name: Glow
description: Rounded corners and a window border with a soft edge glow. A multipass demo: buffer0.frag and buffer1.frag apply a separable Gaussian blur (horizontal then vertical) to the captured surface, and effect.frag composites it as a screen-blended inner glow, an outer halo in the shadow margin, and a crisp rim highlight on top of the same rounded-corner / border clip as the Border pack. Static (no time-based animation); radius, width and colour come from the host.
author: PlasmaZones
